overview: AssamRoots is an Assamese-first e-commerce and community platform connecting the Assamese diaspora with authentic products and services from Assam. Features culturally-themed Assamese design, full product catalog, service booking, admin management panel, and Razorpay payments.
features: Assamese-themed color palette (Gamosa red, Muga gold, Bihu saffron)
Full product catalog with 110+ Assamese products
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
